title: Crimson Rhapsody

outfit_card.silhouette: A structured rococo ballgown featuring a fitted boned corset, ruffled off-shoulder puff sleeves, and an asymmetrical split overskirt flaring over a voluminous tiered petticoat.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An oversized layered headbow combining crimson harlequin-print fabric, golden lace trims, and delicate miniature side bows with pearl drop hairpins.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A deep crimson velvet corset bodice adorned with harlequin center panels, a golden heart brooch, multi-strand pearl chains, and gathered off-shoulder puff sleeves with ruffled lace cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: An open-front crimson velvet sweeping ballgown skirt revealing tiered cream-and-gold harlequin petticoats printed with vintage bear illustrations, paired with patterned argyle stockings and bow-accented heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A floating stitched plush doll wearing a tiny jester party hat and ruffled collar, surrounded by stage curtains, warm spotlights, and circus teddy motifs.
